LESSON: MARKETING AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Agricultural Technologies and Entrepreneurshi p
Topic 3.4: Marketing agricultural produce
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Marketing agricultural produce, part of Agricultural Technologies and Entrepreneurshi p in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 AGRICULTURE.

Key inquiry question: How can we prepare agricultural produce for the market?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Marketing agricultural produce together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: Learner develops self-awareness and planning skills when demonstrating how to prepare vegetable crop

produce for marketing and display produce to the class.

● Communication and collaboration: learner develops effective writing skills when demonstrating how to prepare (through

branding and labelling) and display agriculture produce for marketing.

Values

● Integrity: learner develops honesty by demonstrating proper sorting and grading, weighing, labelling, branding and fair

pricing when marketing agricultural produce and observing ethics when using online marketing platforms.

● Respect: learner uses courteous words when inquiring about expenses incurred in marketing activities from a resource

person.

Values:
● Integrity: learner develops honesty by demonstrating proper sorting and grading, weighing, labelling, branding and fair

pricing when marketing agricultural produce and observing ethics when using online marketing platforms.

● Respect: learner uses courteous words when inquiring about expenses incurred in marketing activities from a resource

person.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Financial literacy: learner learns how to earn income after learning how vegetable crops produce are prepared, displayed

and sold in the market and how to determine if marketing of agricultural produce is financially worthwhile after taking

into account all the expenses incurred.

● Social-economic and environmental issues: learner develops netiquette skills when discussing online marketing platforms

for agricultural produce.

62

● Social-economic and environmental issues: learner develops skills on safe road use by walking on the walk ways and

using designated crossing points when visiting a market to observe how agricultural produce is prepared for marketing.

Suggested Learning Resources: Sample agricultural produce such as vegetable, cereals, pulses milk, eggs, chicks, the local

market, adapted computers with appropriate accessibility features, Appropriate applications/ software, Ergonomic and head

operated mouse and footboards, Writing resources, Positioning devices, ICT tools with appropriate accessibility features, Other

related services (physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, learner support)
